title: ci(pr-automation): run Check Changeset on open PRs only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4n2wzAmmp4Z6W5jsqtM2qx)_
Fixes #35949
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感。已经合并的拉取请求,事后被车队摘掉待合并标签时,不再冒出一个红色的变更说明检查;仍开着的拉取请求照旧每次都检查。
- 为什么做:替维护者解决误报。合并后的那次标签变动让检查拿主干上自己的合并提交作比较基点,数出零份变更说明而报红,前两天两次被当成合并坏了。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是某个开着的拉取请求漏掉一次变更说明检查;只改一行流水线条件,直接撤回本次合并即可复原。
- 要你做什么:这次改的是 CI 工作流,属人工合并档(Tier H)。需要你或 os-zhuang / hotlong 批准后合并。

## What changes

`.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`, job `changeset-check` only: its job-level `if:` gains a first conjunct, `github.event.pull_request.state == 'open'`, plus a five-line comment naming the post-merge `unlabeled pm:awaiting-merge` event, #35842 (run 44739836712, which logged `Diff base: 9a28a480d2`, that PR's own merge commit) and #35857.

Why the guard is the whole fix: on a closed PR, `merge-base origin/main HEAD` is the PR's own merge commit once main holds it, so the step counts zero added changesets and fails. A closed PR's verdict is final and has nothing left to gate. Open PRs (drafts included: their `state` is `open`) keep every run they have today, on all six subscribed actions. `pr-size` and `auto-label` already exclude label and `edited` events and are untouched.

Premise re-measured on `origin/main` 170ca481f0 before the edit: the `if:` carried only the `skip-changeset` label term and the release-PR term, no PR-state guard.

Whole PR: 7 added, 1 deleted, net 6 lines. No changeset: `.github/**` ships in no package, so this PR takes the `skip-changeset` label (route 2).

## Tests

No unit-tested behaviour changed (workflow config), so no ablation. Every repo check that parses this workflow was run at d508b3a59d, all exit 0:

- `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --self-test` (209 cases) and `--roster`: `Check Changeset` stays rostered as a `skip-changeset` opt-out, now "plus 2 further condition(s) the recogniser does not read". The self-test fixture models the old `if:` text by hand; nothing compares it with the real file, so it needed no update.
- `pnpm check:workflow-status-functions` and its `--self-test`; `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --self-test` (167, including the consumer pins that slice the Check Changeset job); `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --self-test`; `node scripts/pr-labels.mjs --self-test`; `node scripts/check-whole-set-label-write.mjs` and `--self-test`.
- All 36 commands `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived for this diff (including `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, fast tier, 2249 cases): readings in the details block below.

## Acceptance notes

- `actionlint` is not installed in this container: NOT MEASURED locally. The edited `if:` parses with the `yaml` package to the expected single expression.
- The `merge_group` and `push` events never reach this workflow (it subscribes to `pull_request` only), so the new term cannot skip a queue build.

## Verification

Read first: `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`, the `changeset-check` `if:` hunk (the only risk: a wrong spelling would skip the gate on open PRs too).

Two-minute check: on any open PR without `skip-changeset`, `Check Changeset` still runs on every event; on a PR merged after this one lands, removing a label now leaves `Check Changeset` `skipped` instead of `failure`. GitHub reads the workflow at the event's commit, so PRs merged before this one (#35842, #35857, and any later post-merge label event on them) keep the old behaviour. The first live proof is this PR's own post-merge `unlabeled pm:awaiting-merge`.
